english.title: Proceeds of Crime - financial institution make a false statement to comply with customer information order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a financial institution, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTITUTION..), in purported compliance with a requirement of a customer information order made under section 363(1) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, made a statement which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular, or recklessly made a statement which was false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 366(3) and (4)of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a financial institution
failed without reasonable excuse
to comply with a customer information order
in that you made a statement which you knew to be false/misleading in a material particular or
recklessly made a statement which was false/misleading in a material particular

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
